descriptionChirho: One who shares in or participates in something, especially a spiritual reality such as the heavenly calling (Heb 3:1, 3:14) or the divine nature. Emphasizes communal participation in a shared gift or experience. Multilingual evidence: eng 'partakers', spa 'partícipes', hin भागी/सहभागी ('sharer/co-sharer'), arb شركاء ('partners/sharers'), kor 함께 하는 자들 ('those who share together'), swa 'washiriki' ('participants'). The Hindi सहभागी and Korean 함께 하는 자들 emphasize co-participation.

A companion, fellow, or business partner -- someone associated with another by shared activity or relationship rather than shared spiritual inheritance. Used of Christ's 'companions' (Heb 1:9, quoting Ps 45:7) and of fishing partners (Lk 5:7). Multilingual evidence clusters distinctly: eng 'companions/partners', spa 'compañeros' (both clusters), hin साथियों/साझीदारों ('associates/business partners'), kor 동료들/동업자들 ('colleagues/business partners'), swa 'wenzako/washirika' ('your fellows/associates'). The Hindi साझीदार and Korean 동업자 signal commercial/social association.
